blank.description: Keeps the notch black when no module above it is active.

claude-code.companion_size_hint: The little creatures that can replace a session's dot (right-click the session).
claude-code.description: Your Claude Code sessions' activity, live.
claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.timeout_hint: In minutes, if its terminal was closed abruptly.
clock.compact_hint: The closed notch, and the mini-notch when the module is pinned.
clock.description: The time and date in the notch.
clock.name: Date and time
companion.module.description: A little companion living in the notch: it dances to music, runs with the stopwatch, sleeps the rest of the time.
companion.module.name: Companion
companion.pack.empty_animation: The "{name}" animation has no picture in "frames"
companion.pack.frame_out_of_range: "{name}" animation: picture {frame} is not in the sheet
companion.pack.frame_size: Pictures must have a 3:2 ratio (24 × 16, 48 × 32…), 8 to 64 pixels high
companion.pack.invalid_fps: "{name}" animation: fps must be between 0 and 60
companion.pack.invalid_frame: "{name}" animation: "{frame}" is neither a number nor an "a-b" range
companion.pack.invalid_sheet: The sheet is not a readable PNG
companion.pack.sheet_size: The sheet does not hold a whole number of pictures of the given size
companion.pack.too_big: The pack is too big (2 MB and 2048 × 2048 pixels at most)
media.description: What's playing on the computer, controlled from the notch.
media.hide_text: Hide the text in the notch
media.hide_text_hint: The closed notch shows only the cover; "Title – Artist" shows for 3 seconds whenever the track changes.
media.hide_text_pin: Hide the text in the pin
media.hide_text_pin_hint: The closed pin shows only the cover; "Title – Artist" shows for 3 seconds whenever the track changes.
media.progress_hint: A thin line along the closed notch's outline moves on with the track.
media.replace_windows_hint: The play / pause, next and previous keys go through Minim Notch: Windows no longer shows its window, the notch shows the music instead.
media.name: Media
media.scroll: Scroll texts that are too long
media.scroll_hint: In the closed notch and the pin, "Title – Artist" scrolls if it does not fit; otherwise it is cut.
screen.label: Screen {number} · {width} × {height}
settings.appearance.hint: Light or dark notch and settings. System follows the mode chosen in Windows.
settings.auto_hide.hint: The notch and the pins slide into the edge when unused, leaving a thin line. Push the cursor against the edge to bring them out; alerts bring them out too.
settings.autostart: Start Minim Notch with the computer
settings.companions.anim.question: Question
settings.companions.hint: Your own companions, to pick with a right click on a Claude Code session or in the Companion module. Start from the template to draw yours.
settings.companions.intro: Companions are available in the {companion} and {claude} modules.
settings.crash.hint: On {date}. The report helps fix the problem: copy it to attach it to your message. It only holds the version, the system and the end of the log, without your home folder.
settings.crash.title: Minim Notch stopped unexpectedly
settings.edge.hint: Changing edge centers the notch again. On the left and right, the notch is thin and vertical: it opens on hover.
settings.fullscreen.hint: Games, videos, presentations. The desktop and Alt+Tab don't count.
settings.fullscreen.resistance: When off, the cursor resistance also stays on in fullscreen.
settings.help.hint: A problem, a translation to fix, an idea: open an issue on GitHub, with the report if needed.
settings.layout.hint: When several modules show: in the notch, separated by a line, or each in its own card, under the notch.
settings.license.hint: The core of Minim Notch is free software under the GPL-3.0 license.
settings.log.missing: The log does not exist yet
settings.module.enable_first: Enable the module to set it up
settings.module.pin_enable_first: Enable the module to pin it
settings.module.pin_first: The first module is always in the notch
settings.module.pin_side: Side of the notch where the pin goes
settings.module.pin_side_vertical: Left: above the notch, Right: below
settings.modules.intro: Drag a module by its handle to choose its display order in the notch: the first is the closest to the edge. The pin puts a module in its own small notch, next to the main one.
settings.move.hint: Drag it along its edge; it snaps to the center and the quarters. Turns off when the settings close.
settings.off_center: The notch is no longer centered on its edge.
settings.pin_flares.hint: Like the notch, each pin flares out in a small curve where it meets the edge of the screen.
settings.resistance.hint: The cursor stops against the notch: push to enter.
settings.resistance.impassable_hint: The cursor can no longer enter: the notch no longer opens on hover or takes clicks, only alerts open it. Move mode suspends the resistance.
settings.resistance.windows_only: Only available on Windows for now.
settings.screen.hint: If it is unplugged, the notch goes back to the primary screen.
settings.sound.hint: When a module needs your attention: permission, question, task done, error
settings.speed.hint: When the notch opens on hover or for an alert, and closes.
settings.style.hint: A notch glued to the screen edge, or a pill detached from it, Dynamic Island style.
settings.updates.auto.hint: At startup, then once a day. Nothing is installed without your consent.
settings.updates.dev: The development version does not check for updates
settings.updates.install.hint: Minim Notch closes during the installation, then restarts.
settings.updates.up_to_date: Minim Notch is up to date
stopwatch.description: A stopwatch to start from the notch.
stopwatch.name: Stopwatch
timer.default_hint: In minutes, the timer's duration when it starts. At 0, add the minutes from the notch.
timer.description: A countdown that rings when it ends.
timer.duration_range: The duration must be between 0 and {max} minutes
timer.favorites_hint: In minutes, separated by commas (5 at most). A click in the notch picks one.
timer.favorites_range: Favorite durations must be between 1 and {max} minutes
timer.name: Timer
updates.check_failed: Cannot check for updates. Check the Internet connection.
volume.description: The sound volume, adjustable from the notch.
volume.name: Volume
volume.replace_windows_hint: The volume keys go through Minim Notch: Windows no longer shows its volume window, the notch shows the level instead.
